name: Current and Emerging Issues in Strategic Management
description: The students will be able to learn about the key concepts and analytical frameworks developed by academic writers. The learning approach centres at the practical application of the knowledge - how to use the knowledge to analyse and evaluate organisational strategies. The course places significant emphasis on the practical relevance of the concepts to what firms are actually doing. The practice of strategic management is captured by four methods namely case studies, present or past experince, current company reports and articles, and the last video interview clips with CEOs, commentators and key speakers. Students will develop the analytical skills to support strategic judgements and improve your ability to think strategically.
